topic: C01 Who Audits the Agents? Human Oversight as a Measurable Capability
data: Synthetic. 1,500 live AI refund decisions (true error rate 8%), 3 sites x 4 reviewers, 2 reviewers per decision (3% escalated to 3), plus a golden set of 300 expert-verified cases (25% errors) seeded blind into the queues. Seed 20261101.
how_to_reproduce: python3 data/generate_data.py; Rscript r/analysis.R; python3 python/analysis.py

results.name: percent_agreement_all
results.meaning: Raw share of reviewer pairs on the same decision that gave the same label, all sites.

results.name: percent_agreement_site_A
results.meaning: Raw agreement among Site A reviewers.

results.name: estimated_live_error_rate
results.meaning: Live AI error rate estimated from Sites A+B flag rate corrected for their gold sensitivity/specificity (true value 0.08; realized 0.079). Overestimated in this seed because golden-set specificity (0.98-0.99) runs above the true ~0.95.

results.name: estimated_live_error_rate_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound, live error rate: case-level bootstrap. Python and R bootstrap RNGs differ, so bounds may differ slightly.

results.name: approve_everything_accuracy

results.name: sensitivity_all
results.meaning: Share of true-error reviews (golden set) labelled 'Error', all sites.

results.name: sensitivity_site_A
results.meaning: Site A error-catch rate: share of reviews of true errors labelled 'Error' (47 of 50).

results.name: sensitivity_site_A_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound, Site A sensitivity: case-level bootstrap (2,000 resamples of golden cases; reviews are clustered within cases). Python and R bootstrap RNGs differ, so bounds may differ slightly.

results.name: sensitivity_site_A_ci_high
results.meaning: 95% CI upper bound, Site A sensitivity: case-level bootstrap. Python and R bootstrap RNGs differ, so bounds may differ slightly.

results.name: specificity_site_A
results.meaning: Site A: share of reviews of truly correct decisions labelled 'Correct' (144 of 146).

results.name: missed_by_both_site_A
results.meaning: Site A: share of golden-set true errors where every reviewer said 'Correct' (0 of 25).

results.name: errors_slipping_per_1000_site_A
results.meaning: Estimated AI errors per 1,000 decisions that pass Site A review unflagged (estimated live error rate x missed-by-both rate). Biased upward in this seed because the live error rate is overestimated (true value in true_parameters.site_implied_errors_slipping_per_1000).

results.name: errors_slipping_per_1000_site_A_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound, Site A errors per 1,000: case-level bootstrap. Python and R bootstrap RNGs differ, so bounds may differ slightly.

results.name: errors_slipping_per_1000_site_A_ci_high
results.meaning: 95% CI upper bound, Site A errors per 1,000: case-level bootstrap. With 0 golden errors missed by both reviewers, every resample gives 0, so the interval collapses to 0-0; the true rate is small but not zero. Python and R bootstrap RNGs differ, so bounds may differ slightly.
